item.text: {"explanation":"Rule: for each key, retain the event with maximum (version, deleted, actor, value); expose it as visible unless deleted, otherwise list the key in sorted order. This preserves tombstones and makes delivery order irrelevant. A lower-version write cannot defeat a deletion; same-version deletion wins. The foil changes an emitted value or key, violating this invariant.","mapping":"Input events map to per-key maxima; maxima map to visible values or tombstone keys. State stores the current winning event for each key.","assumptions":"Inputs satisfy the stated event and JSON constraints. Sorting uses Unicode code-point order.","applies":"function applies(input){return true}","holds":"function holds(input,output){function cp(a,b){var x=Array.from(a),y=Array.from(b),n=Math.min(x.length,y.length);for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var p=x[i].codePointAt(0),q=y[i].codePointAt(0);if(p!=q)return p-q}return x.length-y.length}function better(a,b){if(!b)return true;if(a.version!=b.version)return a.version>b.version;if(!!a.deleted!=!!b.deleted)return a.deleted?1:-1;var c=cp(a.actor,b.actor);if(c)return c>0;return cp(a.value,b.value)>0}var m={};for(var e of input.events)if(better(e,m[e.key]))m[e.key]=e;var v={},t=[];for(var k in m)if(m[k].deleted)t.push(k);else v[k]=m[k].value;t.sort(cp);if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!=input.events.length)return false;for(var i=0;i<output.length;i++){var mm={};for(var j=0;j<=i;j++)if(better(input.events[j],mm[input.events[j].key]))mm[input.events[j].key]=input.events[j];var vv={},tt=[];for(var z in mm)if(mm[z].deleted)tt.push(z);else vv[z]=mm[z].value;tt.sort(cp);if(JSON.stringify(output[i])!==JSON.stringify({visible:vv,tombstones:tt}))return false}return true}","program":"function solve(x){var s=x.state||{},m=s.m||{},e=x.event;function cp(a,b){var x=Array.from(a),y=Array.from(b),n=Math.min(x.length,y.length);for(var i=0;i<n;i++){var p=x[i].codePointAt(0),q=y[i].codePointAt(0);if(p!==q)return p-q}return x.length-y.length}function win(a,b){if(!b)return true;if(a.version!==b.version)return a.version>b.version;if(!!a.deleted!==!!b.deleted)return !!a.deleted;var c=cp(a.actor,b.actor);return c?c>0:cp(a.value,b.value)>0}if(win(e,m[e.key]))m[e.key]={key:e.key,version:e.version,actor:e.actor,deleted:e.deleted,value:e.value};var v={},t=[];for(var k in m){if(m[k].deleted)t.push(k);else v[k]=m[k].value}t.sort(cp);return {state:{m:m},output:{visible:v,tombstones:t}}}"}
